title: The nest sways in the wind
odia:
ବାୟାର କି ଯାଏ,
ବାଆ କଲେ ବସା ଦୋହଲୁଥାଏ।
literal_meaning: What does it matter to the baya bird? When the wind blows, its nest keeps swaying.
meaning_odia: ବାଆ କଲେ ବସା ଦୋହଲୁଛି, ତଥାପି ବାୟାର କି ଯାଏ—ପଙ୍କ୍ତିର ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଏକ ନିଶ୍ଚିନ୍ତ ଭାବ ଆଣୁଛି। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ, ଚାରିପାଖର ହଲଚଲକୁ ବଡ଼ କ୍ଷତି ବୋଲି ନଧରିବାର ଚିତ୍ର ଏହା। ପ୍ରୟୋଗ ଅନୁସାରେ ଏହା ଆଶ୍ୱାସନ ବା କାହାର ନିର୍ବିକାର ଭାବ ପ୍ରତି ଥଟ୍ଟା ହୋଇପାରେ।
explanation: The nest moves, but the opening question asks what difference that makes to its occupant. Read editorially, the couplet treats surrounding disturbance with unconcern. It may reassure someone or tease a person who remains untroubled; the wording alone does not settle that tone.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Amid a bustle of complaints, one person remains relaxed. A friend recalls the baya bird whose nest sways in the wind, leaving it open whether the remark admires or teases that calm.
cultural_context: The repeated ବ sounds connect bird, wind and nest. The movement belongs to the nest; the question places the bird at a distance from the surrounding fuss. This is a rhetorical image, not a guarantee that nests withstand every wind.

english_summary: A swaying nest becomes an image of remaining unconcerned.
